# introduce

This project includes all examples from BLE adv to connection to audio output, 
which is a collection of basic functions of Telink BLE.

## hardware
We need at least one development board to run the code.

BLE Example Supported Development Boards:

| MCU Series | Board Model                                                    |
|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| TL721x     | C1TXA104_V1.1(CODEC1-V2)    <br>  C1T315A20  <br> C1T315A20_V2 |
| TLSR952x   | C1T266A20_V1.3   <br>                                          | 
| TL751x     | C1T368A20_V1_1   <br>                                          | 
| TL322x     | C1T371A20_V1_1   <br>  C1T379A20_V1_0                          |
